meta.title: Team of AI agents who do the work. On call 24/7
meta.description: A team of AI agents for your company, and private AI assistants for your own money, week and plans. They work on their own and ask before anything goes out.

hero.headline: Team of AI agents who do the work. On call 24/7
hero.subhead: Staff for your company's research, marketing and support. Assistants for your money and your week. They work on their own, message you on LINE or Slack, and ask before anything goes out.

features.heading: What it does while you get on with your day
features.intro: Not a chat window you have to remember to open. Your agents work on a schedule and come to you.

items.label: Alerts
items.title: It messages you where you already are
items.body: LINE, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams or email. When something needs your OK, when a task fails, and a brief each morning. Reply "pause" to stop.

items.label: Team chat
items.title: One chat with your whole team
items.body: Ask once. The agent with the right tools answers, and brings in a colleague when it needs one. Every hand-off is on the page.

items.label: Vera · Competitor watch
items.title: Your competitors, checked by 6am
items.body: Each competitor's Instagram followers, new posts and best post, compared with yesterday and with your own numbers.

items.label: Juno · Personal assistant
items.title: Your week, planned from your calendar
items.body: Juno reads your Google or Outlook calendar and plans focus time around what's booked. Nothing is added until you approve.

items.label: Penny · Money
items.title: Your spending, added up exactly
items.body: Upload a statement. Penny adds it up in code rather than guessing, hides account numbers, and finds the subscription you forgot.

trust.heading: It asks before it acts
trust.intro: Handing work, or your life admin, to an AI is a big ask. So it drafts, and you decide.

shots.title: Every email and post waits with its full text
shots.body: Every email, post, calendar event and Slack message waits with its full text. Approve, edit or reject.

shots.title: It can, it can't - on every agent
shots.body: Each agent's page says exactly what it does on its own and what it never does without you.

shots.title: Hand-offs you can follow
shots.body: When one agent asks another for help, the whole exchange is one thread in the Audit log.

items.title: Draft-only by default
items.body: A new agent cannot publish or send anything. You allow that yourself, per agent and per tool.

items.title: You approve every send
items.body: Posts and emails wait in Needs you with the full text. Approve, edit or reject — from your phone.

items.title: Answers name their source
items.body: Agents answer from your documents and cited web pages. When the answer isn't there, they say so.

items.title: A full audit log
items.body: Every run, draft and decision is recorded: who did what, and when.

items.title: Private by design
items.body: A personal space can't be shared or reached from outside. Nothing trains AI models. Download or delete it all yourself.

items.title: It knows when to stop
items.body: Each agent has a rule for handing off. When it applies, the agent stops and brings in a person.

roles.heading: Fifteen roles, ready to hire
roles.intro: Nine for your business, six for your own life. Pick one and change anything: its job, its voice, its documents, when it asks you.

proof.caption: On every plan, the Roster opens on your week: what got done, what went out and on whose say-so, and what is waiting for you.

items.a: Right now. Create an account and go straight in. Desker is still in testing and needs your feedback.

items.q: Is it for businesses or for individuals?
items.a: Both. When you sign up you choose a business, a personal space, or both. A business gets AI staff that work with clients and your team. A personal space gets assistants for your own life: money, your week, social media, your career, travel and learning.

items.q: Can it message me on LINE?
items.a: Yes. Under Alerts, add LINE, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams or email, then choose what you hear about: approvals, failures, digests, and a morning brief at the time you pick. You can reply "brief", "news" or "pause" from the chat. WhatsApp is coming.

items.q: Can I have a business and a personal space?
items.a: Yes. Pick "Both" at sign-up, or add the other one later from the switcher at the top of the sidebar. They are separate spaces with separate assistants, context and history; nothing crosses from one to the other.

items.q: How private is my personal space?
items.a: It has one member, you, and nobody can be invited in. Its assistants have no public chat link or widget. Account and card numbers in uploaded statements are masked before any AI reads them. Nothing you share trains an AI model, and you can download or delete everything yourself from Your space.

items.q: What can an agent actually do?
items.a: It searches the documents you upload, researches the web with citations, drafts posts and emails, plans around your calendar, adds up bank statements, schedules its own follow-ups and hands work to a colleague. In a business it can also answer clients on a chat link or a widget on your site.

items.q: Can it spend my money or book things?
items.a: No. There is no tool for paying, buying, booking or signing anything. The money manager reads statements and tells you what to change; the travel planner finds the options; you do the booking.

items.q: Will it ever send something I haven't seen?
items.a: No. Every agent starts in draft-only mode, so posts and emails wait for your approval. You can loosen that per agent and per tool once one has earned it.

items.q: Where do its answers come from?
items.a: From what you told it, the documents you upload (PDF, Word, Markdown, text, CSV) and cited web pages. When the answer is in none of them, it says it doesn't know rather than inventing one.

Today: email through your own Resend account; a support inbox that takes customer messages from any helpdesk, website form or Zapier/Make zap and reports back when each is answered; Google Calendar, Slack and GitHub; and publishing through a webhook. Desker doesn't post to LinkedIn, X or Instagram directly: it sends each post you approve to a Zapier or Make zap, which posts it. HubSpot, Intercom and Salesforce are on the way.

Nothing you upload is used to train an AI model. Every space is readable only by its members, and a personal space only by you. Saved credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Data is stored with our hosting and database providers, Vercel and Neon, and deleted when you delete your account.
About five minutes: answer four questions, pick a role, upload a document if you have one, try it, switch it on. The app has a step-by-step guide for each part.

desks.heading: Hire for the office. Hire for home.
desks.intro: Choose a business, a personal space, or both when you sign up. Each has its own team, its own context, and a wall between them.

business.label: For your business
business.title: A team that runs while you run the company
business.body: Tell it what the business does once. Your staff answer clients, write, research and follow up, and bring you anything that goes out.
points: Support, sales, marketing, research and ops roles
Answers clients from your own policies
Invite your team, roles and approvals for everyone

personal.label: For your life
personal.title: Assistants who know you, and only you
personal.body: Tell them about you once. They plan your week, add up your spending, grow your profile and hunt for your next job, and ask before acting.
points: Money, life admin, social media, career, travel and learning
Adds up your bank statements exactly, not by guessing
Private: no invites, no public link, delete it any time

desks.wall: Nothing in your personal space is visible to your business, its team or its clients.

integrations.heading: Works with what you already use
integrations.intro: Connect an app once, then choose which agents may use it and whether they ask first. Anything else reaches Desker through a webhook or the support inbox.
